verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is a SaaS invoicing product, so an official MCP server is a fair capability to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or agent-connection endpoint. The probes found only a generic company llms.txt and returned 404s for markdown docs and OpenAPI specs, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
